function.name: studio
function.description:
Generate media with the LOCAL Lite studio apps — no API keys, no cloud, runs on this machine's GPU.
YOUR MODEL AND VRAM: every GPU action below SUSPENDS your own local model first (LM Studio, llama.cpp, NInfer, Strata or Xolotl — whichever serves you), runs the job TO THE END inside this one call (async jobs too — you get the finished result, not a job id), has the app give its GPU memory back, then reloads you at the same context. Your FIRST reply afterwards re-reads the whole conversation (KV cache is gone): expect a slow first token. If your seat cannot be freed the call says why and nothing is generated. On a cloud backend nothing is suspended and async actions return a job_id to poll with action=job. NEVER call these apps' HTTP APIs directly for GPU work: that skips the suspend and can OOM the card.
params = the app's own request fields (they win over the shorthand args). wait_s = longest wait for an async job while you are suspended (default 14400); a job still running then is CANCELLED so you can come back.
app=image (LiteImage, must be RUNNING): lookups status | models | loras | config | video_readiness | ultratex_status | job (kind, job_id) | cancel (no args = the running image; or kind + job_id) | scrape (params.urls: list a gallery's images) | unload_model. GPU: generate (prompt + any of width/height/steps/guidance/negative_prompt/seed/sampler/scheduler/batch/lora_dir/init_image_path/strength/clip_skip/output_path/save_to_gallery; params: mask_path = inpaint/outpaint, control_net_model + control_image_path + control_strength + use_canny = ControlNet, ref_image_paths = reference/edit models, weight_type), upscale (params: image_path, upscale_model, repeats, tile_size), faceswap (params: source_image, target_image, output_dir, enhance, enhancer, swapper, fidelity, target_face_idx, source_face_indices, swap_all_faces, occlusion), faceswap_scrape (params: urls + target_image — swaps every image of a gallery), load_model (file_path from action=models). GPU async: video (prompt; params: width, height, steps, guidance_scale, seed, negative_prompt, sampling_method, scheduler, init_image_path, strength, frames, flow_shift, fps, chunk_size, lora_dir — uses the video model chosen in LiteImage's Settings, H3 included), video_upscale (params: source, output, width, height, aspect, fit, crop, provider), faceswap_video (params: video_path, target_path, output_path, enhance, enhancer, occlusion, swapper, fidelity, target_face_idx, every_n_frames, output_fps, output_width, output_height, crf), pipeline (params: steps [{op, errorPolicy}], initial_image, metadata, params), pipeline_batch (params: recipe.steps, axes {prompts, seeds, models}, base_params), ultratex (params: the UltraTex job body). guidance defaults to 3.5 for generate (the LiteImage UI value for flux1-dev; the raw API default of 7.5 overdrives it) — pass it explicitly for other model families.
app=director (LiteImage's H3 Director): describe (start here: open view, project summary, engine state; params.project = full for the whole document) | request (params = a Director request object with its own action: list-projects, get-project, create-project, save-project, edit-project, select-project, import-project, import-file, import-asset, list-checkpoints, create-checkpoint, restore-checkpoint, compile, readiness, export-bundle, import-bundle, suggest, … — writes need params.expectedRevision) | ui (no params = read the view; params = a view command: open, layout, tab, view, seek, play, stop, zoom, fit, select, undo, redo, edit, studio) | screenshot | engine (no params = H3 engine status; params.op = validate | install | cancel | activate | model) | jobs | job (job_id) | cancel (job_id; params.projectId). GPU async: generate (params: projectId, expectedRevision, intent = preview | balanced | final, optional seed, continueRender, fromSceneId, toSceneId, seedSnapshotId) | retry (params: jobId, newSeed).
app=sound (LiteSound, must be RUNNING): status | backends | config | jobs | job (job_id) | cancel (job_id) | gallery | backend_unload. GPU: generate (mode = music | song | sfx | ambient | speech; prompt and/or lyrics; duration seconds; params: genre, mood, backend, format, aceStep, speech) — async, waited on when you are suspended | backend_load (params.backend).
app=model (LiteModeler through the `lst` CLI): status | config | families | list_models | export_skeleton | export_format; GPU: generate (out = .glb path, AND image = input picture OR prompt = text, which needs LiteImage running; family, seed, shape_steps, texture_steps, sparse_steps, target_faces, texture_size, no_texture, sampler, gguf_quant), batch (dir, out_dir), rig (input, out). Every arg or params field is forwarded to `lst run model`.
If an app is not running the call says so — tell the human to open it; do not retry blind.

params.description: The app's own request fields (LiteImage / Director / LiteSound / lst model names). They win over the shorthand args.

wait_s.description: Longest wait for an async job while your model is suspended (default 14400 s).

kind.description: image job / cancel: which kind of job job_id is

job_id.description: the job to poll or cancel

lora_dir.description: image: LoRA search dir override; tag with <lora:name> in prompt

output_path.description: image: copy result to this path

save_to_gallery.description: image: insert into the LiteImage gallery DB

family.description: model: trellis2 | triposplat | pixal3d | hunyuan3d-2.1 | hunyuan3d-omni
